permissionRule.description:
Tool permission rule.
See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#permission-rule-syntax
See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#tools-available-to-claude for full list of tools available to Claude.

async.description: Run this hook asynchronously without blocking Claude Code

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the hook runs

prompt.description: Prompt to evaluate with LLM. Use $ARGUMENTS placeholder for hook input JSON.

model.description: Model to use for evaluation. Defaults to a fast model

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the hook runs

anyOf.description: Agent hook with multi-turn tool access for verification. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#agent-based-hooks

prompt.description: Prompt describing what to verify. Use $ARGUMENTS placeholder for hook input JSON.

model.description: Model to use for evaluation. Defaults to a fast model

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the hook runs

anyOf.description: HTTP webhook hook. POST JSON to a URL and receive JSON response. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#http-hooks

url.description: URL to POST hook input JSON to. Endpoint must accept POST requests and return JSON.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers (e.g., Authorization: Bearer token). Values support $VAR_NAME or ${VAR_NAME} interpolation.

allowedEnvVars.description: List of environment variable names permitted for interpolation in headers. If not set, no env var interpolation is allowed.

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the hook runs

hookMatcher.description: Hook matcher configuration with multiple hooks

matcher.description: Optional pattern to match event contexts, case-sensitive. Behavior depends on event type. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#matcher-patterns for event-specific details and examples

description: Configuration settings for Claude Code. Learn more: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for Claude Code settings  Claude Code 设置的 JSON Schema 参考

apiKeyHelper.description: Path to a script that outputs authentication values  输出认证值的脚本路径

autoMemoryEnabled.description: Enable automatic memory saves that capture useful context to .claude/memory/. Also configurable via CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY environment variable (set to 1 to disable, 0 to enable). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory#auto-memory  启用自动内存保存功能, 用于捕获有用的上下文并将其保存至 `.claude/memory/` 目录. 此功能也可通过环境变量 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY` 进行配置(设为 1 禁用, 设为 0 启用). 详情请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory#auto-memory

autoUpdatesChannel.description: Release channel to follow for updates. Use "stable" for a version that is typically about one week old and skips versions with major regressions, or "latest" (default) for the most recent release. Set DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 to disable updates entirely.  用于接收更新的发布渠道. 请使用'stable'以获取通常发布约一周的版本(该渠道会跳过存在严重功能回退的版本); 或使用'latest'(默认值)以获取最新发布的版本. 将 DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER 设置为 1 即可完全禁用更新.

awsCredentialExport.description: Path to a script that exports AWS credentials  导出 AWS 凭证的脚本路径

awsAuthRefresh.description: Path to a script that refreshes AWS authentication  用于刷新 AWS 身份验证的脚本路径

cleanupPeriodDays.description: Number of days to retain chat transcripts (0 to disable cleanup)  聊天记录保留天数(设为 0 禁用清理)

env.description:
Environment variables to set for Claude Code sessions. Many environment variables provide settings dimensions not available as dedicated settings.json properties (e.g., thinking tokens, prompt caching, bash timeouts, shell configuration). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#environment-variables for the full list.
UNDOCUMENTED: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS (plugin marketplace git timeout in ms, default 120000, see https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#2151).
UNDOCUMENTED: ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS (set to false to opt out of claude.ai MCP servers, see https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#2163).  用于配置 Claude Code 会话的环境变量. 许多环境变量提供了在专门的 `settings.json` 属性中无法直接设置的配置维度(例如: 思考 tokens 数、提示缓存、Bash 超时设置、Shell 配置等). 如需查看完整列表, 请访问: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#environment-variables. 
[未收录于文档]: `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS`(插件市场的 Git 操作超时时间, 单位为毫秒; 默认值为 120000; 详情请参阅: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#2151). 
[未收录于文档]: `ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS`(将其设置为 `false` 即可选择不使用 claude.ai 的 MCP 服务器; 详情请参阅: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#2163).

attribution.description: Customize attribution for git commits and pull requests. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#attribution-settings  自定义 Git 提交和拉取请求的归属信息. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#attribution-settings

commit.description: Attribution for git commits, including any trailers. Empty string hides commit attribution  Git 提交的归属信息(包括所有尾注). 设置为空字符串将隐藏提交归属信息.

pr.description: Attribution for pull request descriptions. Empty string hides pull request attribution  拉取请求描述的归属信息. 设置为空字符串将隐藏拉取请求归属信息.

includeGitInstructions.description: Include built-in git commit and PR workflow instructions in Claude's system prompt. Also configurable via CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS environment variable (set to 1 to disable). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#available-settings  在 Claude 的系统提示中, 包含内置的 Git 提交与 PR 工作流指引. 此设置也可通过环境变量 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` 进行配置(将其设为 `1` 即可禁用). 详情请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#available-settings

includeCoAuthoredBy.description: DEPRECATED. Use 'attribution' instead. Whether to include the co-authored-by Claude byline in git commits and pull requests (default: true)  已弃用. 请改用 'attribution'. 是否在 Git 提交和拉取请求中包含'Co-authored-by: Claude'署名(默认值: true).

plansDirectory.description: Customize where plan files are stored. Path is relative to project root (default: ~/.claude/plans)  自定义计划文件的存储位置. 路径相对于项目根目录(默认值: ~/.claude/plans).

respectGitignore.description: Control whether the @ file picker respects .gitignore patterns. When true (default), files matching .gitignore patterns are excluded from suggestions  控制文件选择器(@)是否遵循 .gitignore 模式. 当设置为 true(默认值)时, 匹配 .gitignore 模式的文件将被排除在建议列表之外.

allow.description: List of permission rules for allowed operations  允许操作的权限规则列表

deny.description: List of permission rules for denied operations  被拒绝操作的权限规则列表

ask.description: List of permission rules that should always prompt for confirmation  始终应提示确认的权限规则列表

defaultMode.description:
Default permission mode.
"default": prompts on first use.
"acceptEdits": auto-accepts file edits.
"plan": read-only, no modifications.
UNDOCUMENTED. "delegate": coordination-only for agent team leads (agent teams are experimental; enable via CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS).
"dontAsk": auto-denies unless pre-approved via permissions.
"bypassPermissions": skips all prompts (use only in isolated environments).
See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions  默认权限模式. 
'default': 首次使用时提示. 
'acceptEdits': 自动接受文件修改. 
'plan': 只读, 不允许修改. 
[未文档化] 'delegate': 仅供代理团队负责人用于协调工作(代理团队功能尚处于实验阶段, 需通过环境变量 `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS` 启用). 
'dontAsk': 自动拒绝, 除非已通过权限设置预先批准. 
'bypassPermissions': 跳过所有提示(仅限在隔离环境中慎用). 
详见 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions

disableBypassPermissionsMode.description: Disable the ability to bypass permission prompts  禁用绕过权限提示的功能

additionalDirectories.description: Additional directories to include in the permission scope  需包含在权限范围内的其他目录

permissions.description:
Tool usage permissions configuration.
See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#permission-settings
See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#tools-available-to-claude for full list of tools available to Claude.  工具使用权限配置. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions 和 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#permission-settings 如需查看 Claude 可用的完整工具列表, 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#tools-available-to-claude

language.description: Preferred language for Claude's responses  Claude 回复的首选语言

model.description: Override the default model used by Claude Code. For finer control, use environment variables: ANTHROPIC_MODEL (runtime override), ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL (per-class pinning), CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL (subagent model). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config  覆盖 Claude Code 所使用的默认模型. 若需进行更精细的控制, 请使用环境变量: ANTHROPIC_MODEL(运行时覆盖)、ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL、ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL、ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL(按类别指定)、CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL( subagent 模型). 详见 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config

availableModels.description: Restrict which models users can select. When defined at multiple settings levels (user, project, etc.), arrays are merged and deduplicated. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#restrict-model-selection  限制用户可选择的模型. 当在多个配置层级(用户、项目等)进行定义时, 数组将被合并并去重. 详见: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#restrict-model-selection

effortLevel.description: Control Opus 4.6 adaptive reasoning effort. Lower effort is faster and cheaper for straightforward tasks, higher effort provides deeper reasoning. Opus 4.6 defaults to medium effort for Max and Team subscribers. Also configurable via CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL environment variable. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level  控制 Opus 4.6 的自适应推理力度. 对于简单直接的任务, 较低的力度能带来更快的速度和更低的成本; 而较高的力度则能实现更深入的推理. 对于 Max 和 Team 订阅用户, Opus 4.6 默认采用中等力度. 此外, 您也可以通过设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` 环境变量来进行配置. 详情请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level

fastMode.description: Enable fast mode for Opus 4.6 (research preview). Fast mode uses the same model with 2.5x faster output at higher per-token cost. Requires extra usage enabled. Alternatively, toggle with /fast command. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode  为 Opus 4.6(研究预览版)启用快速模式. 快速模式使用相同的模型, 但输出速度提升 2.5 倍, 同时每 Token 的成本更高. 需启用额外用量权限. 此外, 也可通过 `/fast` 命令进行切换. 详情请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode

fastModePerSessionOptIn.description: Require per-session opt-in for fast mode. When true, fast mode does not persist across sessions and users must enable it with /fast each session. Useful for controlling costs. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode  要求对'快速模式'进行逐会话选择启用. 若设为 true, 快速模式将不会在不同会话之间自动延续; 用户必须在每个会话中通过输入 `/fast` 命令来手动开启该模式. 此设置有助于控制成本. 详情请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode

enableAllProjectMcpServers.description: Whether to automatically approve all MCP servers in the project. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp  是否自动批准项目中的所有 MCP 服务器. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp

enabledMcpjsonServers.description: List of approved MCP servers from .mcp.json. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp  来自 .mcp.json 的已批准 MCP 服务器列表. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp

disabledMcpjsonServers.description: List of rejected MCP servers from .mcp.json. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp  来自 .mcp.json 的被拒绝 MCP 服务器列表. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp

serverName.description: Name of the MCP server that users are allowed to configure

serverCommand.description: Exact command and arguments used to start stdio servers

serverUrl.description: URL pattern for remote servers, supports wildcards (e.g., https://*.example.com/*)

allowedMcpServers.description: Enterprise allowlist of MCP servers that can be used. Applies to all scopes including enterprise servers from managed-mcp.json. If undefined, all servers are allowed. If empty array, no servers are allowed. Denylist takes precedence - if a server is on both lists, it is denied. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp#restriction-options  企业级 MCP 服务器允许列表, 指定可供使用的服务器. 此设置适用于所有范围, 包括来自 `managed-mcp.json` 文件的企业服务器. 如果未定义此列表, 则允许所有服务器; 如果设置为空数组, 则不允许任何服务器. 拒绝列表具有优先权——如果某台服务器同时出现在允许列表和拒绝列表中, 则该服务器将被拒绝. 详情请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp#restriction-options

serverName.description: Name of the MCP server that is explicitly blocked

serverCommand.description: Exact command and arguments used to start stdio servers

serverUrl.description: URL pattern for remote servers, supports wildcards (e.g., https://*.example.com/*)

deniedMcpServers.description: Enterprise denylist of MCP servers that are explicitly blocked. If a server is on the denylist, it will be blocked across all scopes including enterprise. Denylist takes precedence over allowlist - if a server is on both lists, it is denied. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp#restriction-options  企业级 MCP 服务器黑名单, 用于明确屏蔽特定服务器. 如果某台服务器被列入黑名单, 它将在包括企业级在内的所有范围内遭到屏蔽. 黑名单的优先级高于白名单——如果某台服务器同时出现在这两份列表中, 它将被拒绝访问. 详见: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp#restriction-options

hooks.description: Custom commands to run before/after tool executions. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks  用于在工具执行前/后运行的自定义命令. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks

PreToolUse.description: Hooks that run before tool calls

PostToolUse.description: Hooks that run after tool completion

PostToolUseFailure.description: Hooks that run after a tool fails

PermissionRequest.description: Hooks that run when a permission dialog appears

UserPromptSubmit.description: Hooks that run when a user submits a prompt

Stop.description: Hooks that run when agents finish responding. Does not run on user interrupt

SubagentStart.description: Hooks that run when a subagent is spawned

SubagentStop.description: Hooks that run when subagents finish responding

PreCompact.description: Hooks that run before the context is compacted

TeammateIdle.description: Hooks that run when an agent team teammate is about to go idle. Exit code 2 sends feedback and keeps the teammate working. Does not support matchers. Agent teams are experimental. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#teammateidle

TaskCompleted.description: Hooks that run when a task is being marked as completed. Exit code 2 prevents completion and sends feedback. Does not support matchers. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#taskcompleted

Setup.description: UNDOCUMENTED. Hooks that run during repository initialization (--init, --init-only) or maintenance (--maintenance)

InstructionsLoaded.description: Hooks that run when a CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/*.md file is loaded into context. Fires at session start and when files are lazily loaded (e.g., nested traversal, path glob match). No decision control; used for audit logging and observability. Does not support matchers. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#instructionsloaded

ConfigChange.description: Hooks that run when settings, managed settings, or skill files change during a session. Supports matchers: user_settings, project_settings, local_settings, policy_settings, skills. Command handlers only. Exit code 2 blocks the change (except policy_settings which is audit-only). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#configchange

WorktreeCreate.description: Hooks that run when a worktree is created via --worktree or isolation: "worktree" in subagents. Command handlers only, no matchers. Hook must print absolute path to created worktree on stdout; non-zero exit fails creation. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#worktreecreate

WorktreeRemove.description: Hooks that run when a worktree is being removed at session exit or when a subagent finishes. Command handlers only, no matchers. Used for cleanup tasks; cannot block removal. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#worktreeremove

SessionStart.description: Hooks that run when a new session starts

SessionEnd.description: Hooks that run when a session ends

disableAllHooks.description: Disable all hooks and statusLine execution. When true in managed settings, user and project-level disableAllHooks cannot override it. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#disable-or-remove-hooks  禁用所有钩子(Hooks)及状态行(StatusLine)的执行. 若在托管设置(Managed Settings)中此项设为 true, 则用户级和项目级的 `disableAllHooks` 设置将无法将其覆盖. 详见: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#disable-or-remove-hooks

allowManagedHooksOnly.description: (Managed settings only) Prevent loading of user, project, and plugin hooks. Only allows managed hooks and SDK hooks. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#hook-configuration  (仅限托管设置)禁止加载用户、项目及插件钩子. 仅允许托管钩子和 SDK 钩子. 详见: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#hook-configuration

allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.description: (Managed settings only) Prevent user and project settings from defining allow, ask, or deny permission rules. Only rules in managed settings apply. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#permission-settings  (仅限受管设置)禁止用户和项目设置定义'允许'、'询问'或'拒绝'权限规则. 仅受管设置中的规则生效. 请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#permission-settings

type.description: The type of status line handler; must be set to "command" to run a custom shell script that receives JSON session data via stdin.  状态行处理程序的类型; 必须设置为'command', 以便运行一个通过标准输入(stdin)接收 JSON 会话数据的自定义 Shell 脚本.

command.description: A shell command or path to a script that displays session information (context usage, costs, git status, etc.) by reading JSON data from stdin and writing output to stdout. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline  一条 Shell 命令或脚本路径, 用于通过读取标准输入(stdin)中的 JSON 数据, 并将输出写入标准输出(stdout), 从而显示会话信息(包括上下文用量、成本、Git 状态等). 详见: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline

padding.description: Optional number of extra horizontal spacing characters added to the status line content; defaults to 0.  添加到状态行内容的额外水平间距字符数(可选); 默认为 0.

statusLine.description: Custom status line display configuration. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline  自定义状态行显示配置. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline

type.description: The type of file suggestion handler; must be set to "command" to execute a custom shell script that generates file suggestions for the @ file picker.  文件建议处理程序的类型; 必须设置为'command', 以便执行一个自定义 Shell 脚本, 为 @ 文件选择器生成文件建议.

command.description: Shell command to execute for file suggestions  用于文件建议的 Shell 命令

fileSuggestion.description: Configure a custom script for @ file autocomplete. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#file-suggestion-settings  配置用于 @ 文件自动补全的自定义脚本. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#file-suggestion-settings

enabledPlugins.description: Enabled plugins using plugin-id@marketplace-id format. Example: { "formatter@anthropic-tools": true }. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins  启用使用 `plugin-id@marketplace-id` 格式的插件. 示例: `{ "formatter@anthropic-tools": true }`. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins

pathPattern.description: Regex pattern to match file or directory paths for marketplace sources

skippedMarketplaces.description: List of marketplace names the user has chosen not to install when prompted  用户在收到提示时选择不安装的市场名称列表

skippedPlugins.description: List of plugin IDs (plugin@marketplace format) the user has chosen not to install when prompted  用户在收到提示时选择不安装的插件 ID 列表(格式为 plugin@marketplace)

forceLoginMethod.description: Force a specific login method: "claudeai" for Claude Pro/Max, "console" for Console billing  强制使用特定的登录方式: 'claudeai'用于 Claude Pro/Max, 'console'用于 Console 计费.

forceLoginOrgUUID.description: Organization UUID to use for OAuth login  用于 OAuth 登录的组织 UUID

otelHeadersHelper.description: Path to a script that outputs OpenTelemetry headers  输出 OpenTelemetry 标头的脚本路径

outputStyle.description: Controls the output style for assistant responses. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/output-styles  控制助手回复的输出风格. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/output-styles

skipWebFetchPreflight.description: Skip the WebFetch blocklist check for enterprise environments with restrictive security policies  针对具有严格安全策略的企业环境, 跳过 WebFetch 黑名单检查.

sandbox.description: Sandbox execution configuration. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing  沙盒执行配置. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing

network.description: Configures network isolation settings for the sandboxed bash environment, including domain restrictions, Unix socket access, and custom proxy configuration.

allowUnixSockets.description: Allow Unix domain sockets for local IPC (SSH agent, Docker, etc.). Provide an array of specific paths. Defaults to blocking if not specified

allowLocalBinding.description: Allow binding to local network addresses (e.g., localhost ports). Defaults to false if not specified

httpProxyPort.description: HTTP proxy port to use for network filtering. If not specified, a proxy server will be started automatically

socksProxyPort.description: SOCKS proxy port to use for network filtering. If not specified, a proxy server will be started automatically

allowAllUnixSockets.description: Allow all Unix domain socket connections. If true, this overrides allowUnixSockets

allowedDomains.description: Allowlist of network domains for sandboxed commands. Supports wildcard patterns like *.example.com

allowManagedDomainsOnly.description: (Managed settings only) Only allowedDomains and WebFetch(domain:...) allow rules from managed settings are respected. User, project, local, and flag settings domains are ignored. Denied domains are still respected from all sources.

additionalProperties.description: List of filesystem paths to ignore sandbox violations for when this command pattern matches

ignoreViolations.description: Map of command patterns to filesystem paths to ignore violations for. Use "*" to match all commands

excludedCommands.description: Commands that should never run in the sandbox (e.g., ["git", "docker"])

autoAllowBashIfSandboxed.description: Automatically allow bash commands without prompting when they run in the sandbox. Only applies to commands that will run sandboxed.

enableWeakerNetworkIsolation.description: macOS only. Allow access to the system TLS trust service (com.apple.trustd.agent) in the sandbox. Required for Go-based tools like gh, gcloud, and terraform to verify TLS certificates when using httpProxyPort with a MITM proxy and custom CA. Reduces security by opening a potential data exfiltration path. Default: false. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#sandbox-settings

enableWeakerNestedSandbox.description: Enable weaker sandbox mode for unprivileged docker environments where --proc mounting fails. This significantly reduces the strength of the sandbox and should only be used when this risk is acceptable.Default: false (secure).

allowUnsandboxedCommands.description: Allow commands to run outside the sandbox via the dangerouslyDisableSandbox parameter. When false, the dangerouslyDisableSandbox parameter is completely ignored and all commands must run sandboxed. Default: true.

filesystem.description: Filesystem access control for sandboxed commands. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing#filesystem-isolation

allowWrite.description: Paths where subprocesses are allowed to write. Supports prefixes: // (absolute), ~/ (home directory), / (relative to settings file), ./ or no prefix (relative path)

denyWrite.description: Paths where subprocesses are explicitly denied write access. Takes precedence over allowWrite

denyRead.description: Paths where subprocesses are explicitly denied read access

spinnerVerbs.description: Customize the verbs shown in spinner progress messages  自定义旋转进度消息中显示的动词

mode.description: How to combine custom verbs with default spinner verbs: 'append' adds custom verbs to the default list, 'replace' uses only custom verbs

verbs.description: Custom verbs used in spinner progress text

spinnerTipsEnabled.description: Show tips in the spinner while Claude is working. Set to false to disable tips (default: true)  在 Claude 工作期间, 于加载动画中显示提示. 设为 false 可禁用提示(默认值: true).

spinnerTipsOverride.description: Customize the tips displayed in the spinner while Claude is working. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#available-settings  自定义 Claude 工作期间加载动画中显示的提示. 请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#available-settings

excludeDefault.description: If true, only show custom tips. If false or absent, custom tips merge with built-in tips

tips.description: Custom tip strings to display in the spinner

terminalProgressBarEnabled.description: Enable the terminal progress bar that shows progress in supported terminals like Windows Terminal and iTerm2 (default: true)  启用终端进度条, 在 Windows Terminal 和 iTerm2 等受支持的终端中显示进度(默认值: true)

showTurnDuration.description: Show turn duration messages after responses (e.g., "Cooked for 1m 6s"). Set to false to hide these messages (default: true)  在响应后显示回合持续时间信息(例如: '烹饪了 1 分 6 秒'). 设为 false 以隐藏此类信息(默认值: true).

prefersReducedMotion.description: Reduce or disable UI animations (spinners, shimmer, flash effects) for accessibility  为提升无障碍体验, 减少或禁用 UI 动画(如旋转加载、微光效果、闪烁特效).

alwaysThinkingEnabled.description: Enable extended thinking by default for all sessions. Typically configured via the /config command rather than editing directly. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/common-workflows#use-extended-thinking-thinking-mode  默认对所有会话启用'扩展思考'功能. 通常应通过 `/config` 命令进行配置, 而非直接手动编辑. 详见: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/common-workflows#use-extended-thinking-thinking-mode

companyAnnouncements.description: Company announcements to display at startup (one will be randomly selected if multiple are provided)  启动时显示的公告(若提供多条, 将随机选取其中一条)

teammateMode.description: How agent team teammates display: "auto" picks split panes in tmux or iTerm2, in-process otherwise. Agent teams are experimental and disabled by default. Enable them by adding CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS to your settings.json or environment. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams  Agent 团队成员的显示方式: 'auto'模式下, 若运行于 tmux 或 iTerm2 环境, 将采用分屏显示; 否则, 将以内嵌进程的形式显示. Agent 团队功能目前尚处于实验阶段, 默认处于禁用状态. 若要启用该功能, 请在您的 settings.json 文件或环境变量中添加 CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS 配置项. 详情请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams

pluginTrustMessage.description: (Managed settings only) Custom message appended to the plugin trust warning shown before installation. Use to provide organization-specific context about approved plugins. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#plugin-settings  (仅限受管设置)附加至安装前显示的插件信任警告中的自定义消息. 用于提供关于已批准插件的特定于组织的情境信息. 请参阅: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#plugin-settings

mcpServers.description: User configuration values for MCP servers keyed by server name

pluginConfigs.description: Per-plugin configuration including MCP server user configs, keyed by plugin ID (plugin@marketplace format). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins  按插件 ID(格式为 `plugin@marketplace`)索引的逐插件配置, 其中包括 MCP 服务器的用户配置. 详见 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins

allowManagedMcpServersOnly.description: (Managed settings only) Only allowedMcpServers from managed settings are respected. deniedMcpServers still merges from all sources. Users can still add their own MCP servers, but only the admin-defined allowlist applies.  (仅限托管设置)仅托管设置中指定的 allowedMcpServers 会被采纳. deniedMcpServers 仍会合并来自所有来源的配置. 用户仍可自行添加 MCP 服务器, 但仅管理员定义的允许列表会生效.

blockedMarketplaces.description: (Managed settings only) Blocklist of marketplace sources. These exact sources are blocked from being added as marketplaces. The check happens before downloading, so blocked sources never touch the filesystem.
